item.title: Blog Post: Python Users: Let’s start using plotnine + ggplot
item.description: I don’t pretend to think that R and python are the same, and I also don’t think one really completely outperforms the other (especially conditional on specific research areas). That being said, I think the “Grammar Graphics” (@reference) paradigm that exists through the R package ggplot2 (and also is the foundation for stand-alone graphical software like Tableau) can be useful to abstract-ify the building of graphics. Moreover R’s ggplot2 “tidy” and consistent parameter structure makes building graphics with ggplot easy and enjoyable.
